SUPERVISOR DISPATCH — model-view camera focus. Marker: CAMFOCUS-0606.

USER VERDICT, verbatim: "i had a worker change the camera that is in place when u view a model. the problem was i could rotate around the sides but not the tops and bottoms, well the camera ended up changing to a more freeform camera, which is helpful yes, but the camera is offset on load every time, its a pain to work with, and even tho i have full radial control now, its arguably worse the more ive used it. i think the worker said tho that they left the other locked camera around, but im not even sure how you toggle between them. either way. dont remove anything but the focus of the camera needs fixed."

Context to find first: GRABFLY-0605 (commit 84f35d851) added the noclip fly camera on /characters; the model-view lineage is shared by the /characters preview and the workbench character stage (another lane just landed there — editors/workbench — coordinate by NOT touching their files beyond the camera rig seam; if the fix lives in a file they own, STOP and report).

The ruling, unpacked — DO NOT REMOVE EITHER CAMERA:
1. BOOT FOCUS FIXED: on load (and on part/model switch), the camera frames the model correctly EVERY time — centered on the subject's bounds, sane distance, no offset drift. Find WHY it loads offset (data first: log the boot pose vs the subject bounds) and fix the cause, not a cosmetic nudge.
2. TOGGLE DISCOVERABLE: the locked/orbit camera reportedly still exists — wire an explicit, visible toggle between locked-orbit and freeform (a control on the surface + a key, taught in the help/hint line). If the locked rig is actually gone, say so honestly and restore it from its lineage.
3. A refocus verb: one key/control that re-centers the camera on the subject from any lost position (the escape hatch for "pain to work with").
4. V26 compliance: whatever you touch stays native-driven; JS may solve boot/refocus framing through the registry's pure math only.
P2: framing distances/angles are tunables. Explicit paths, ledger req resolution (this ask was hook-captured if typed in a pane — find and resolve it; otherwise log it), doc touch, verify green. READY FOR USER TEST — the user loading a model and it being framed right every single time is the PASS.
resolution: CAMFOCUS-0606 fixed in commit a5d086305. Measured cause: the sculpt camera (shared by /characters, /items, and the workbench character stage via editors/sculptCamera.ts) booted in fly mode and restored the persisted noclip pose verbatim — the on-disk twig held a pose aimed off-subject (orbit's pan was pinned at its clamp, yaw at -365 deg), so the camera loaded offset every time and never reframed on model/part switch. Fix, with NEITHER camera removed: (1) deterministic subject framing — new pure-math editors/sculptFraming.ts (V26-clean) frames the subject's bounds at a fov-fitted distance at boot, on model load/generate/import and part switch, in BOTH rigs; (2) the orbit/fly toggle made discoverable — explicit orbit + fly chips (active lit) plus the C key, taught in both hint lines; (3) a refocus verb — the 'focus · F' chip and the F key reframe from any lost position. Framing margin is a P2 tunable (TUNE.frame.margin); pose persistence machinery untouched. Verify: new sculptFraming suite 7/7, characters 13/13, full game verify 55/56 (the one RED is the paint lane's uncommitted brush work, unrelated). READY FOR USER TEST: load a model — it frames centered every time; F recenters; C or the chips flip cameras.
